name: 21245-prefill-125m-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One engine on one GPU.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=200 req/s, bounded at 2000 requests with a 900 s safety cap, first 20% discarded as warmup.
workload: GuideLLM synthetic_text, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 700 tokens, output exactly 1 (the backend sets ignore_eos whenever max_tokens is set). request_format is plain: this checkpoint's tokenizer has no chat template, so the default-template path fails on it. temperature 0.0 is the only sampling parameter set.
purpose: A compact 125M-parameter classifier returning one-token verdicts on 700-token documents at 200 requests per second on a single GPU.
launch:
# vLLM at commit bc8a8ce5ec374dd18e86f59be7cb0057a4b21992 (v0.10.0rc1-36-gbc8a8ce5ec).
# Interpreter and hardware seal: configs/env.yaml (not portable, per-machine).

model: facebook/opt-125m
dtype: float16
swap-space: 16
disable-log-requests: true
tensor-parallel-size: 1

# Pinned by hand, NOT defaults: at this commit `vllm serve` resolves these to 1024 / 8192 on a
# >=70 GiB non-A100 card, while an in-process AsyncLLMEngine falls through to 128 / 2048.
max-num-seqs: 1024
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192

# enable-prefix-caching is left unset on purpose: V1 turns it on by default at this commit.
# Setting it false here would be a deviation from the declared launch.
